shared_elements: schematic frontal human figure with raised/bent arms and splayed fingers
crescent / curved hull-like shapes with attached short strokes
radiating lines from a head or upper element
rows of repeated short vertical strokes
linear, outline-based schematic rendering of bodies
justification: Both surfaces depict highly schematic stick-limbed anthropomorphs with raised arms and splayed fingers, and both contain crescent/hull-shaped curved forms edged with rows of short strokes, a fairly specific and comparable motif pair. However, A is a single dominant axial figure with a rayed head enclosing smaller subordinate motifs, whereas B is a dispersed multi-register scene of many small crewed boats, animals and a large ladder/grid, so the compositional logic and the relationships between figures differ markedly.
